climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Michigan AVA on a 330-square-mile peninsula between Lake Michigan and Grand Traverse Bay. The lake effect moderates temperature extremes and delays budding past the late spring frosts.
